name: Dynamic equilibrium
subject: Chemistry
description: At equilibrium, forward and reverse reaction rates are equal. Reactions continue and concentrations stay constant.

name: Law of mass action
subject: Chemistry
description: In the equilibrium expression, each concentration is raised to its stoichiometric coefficient. Pure solids and liquids have unit activity.

name: Equilibrium constant Kc
subject: Chemistry
description: Kc is the ratio of product to reactant concentration terms at equilibrium. Its value depends on temperature.

name: Kp and gaseous moles
subject: Chemistry
description: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn, where Δn is gaseous product coefficients minus gaseous reactant coefficients.

name: Le Chatelier’s principle
subject: Chemistry
description: A system shifts to oppose a concentration, pressure or temperature change. A catalyst changes the rate of reaching equilibrium, not its position.

name: Standard quadratic form
subject: Mathematics
description: A quadratic has the form ax² + bx + c = 0, with a ≠ 0. Move every term to one side before identifying coefficients.

name: Factorisation
subject: Mathematics
description: Write the quadratic as a product equal to zero. At least one factor must be zero; solve both factors.

name: Discriminant
subject: Mathematics
description: D = b² − 4ac. D > 0 means two distinct real roots; D = 0 means equal real roots; D < 0 means no real roots.

name: Quadratic formula
subject: Mathematics
description: For ax² + bx + c = 0, x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac))/(2a). Keep the entire numerator over 2a.

name: Word problems
subject: Mathematics
description: Define the variable, form a quadratic and check roots against the context. Lengths and counts must be valid.
